en: ...It's a dead end.{PAGE}Still, this place is eerily quiet. It looks{SAUT}like humans really don't exist around{SAUT}here.
This is a world where mankind has gone{SAUT}extinct, correct?{PAGE}I was thinking that perhaps we'd come{SAUT}across someone somewhere, but I{SAUT}haven't seen anyone...
They're hiding.{OPTION}They've all been frozen.
Hiding...? Are you saying they're{SAUT}forming some sort of resistance?
That sounds so cool!{PAGE}Like, they're lurking deep underground,{SAUT}just waiting for the right moment to{SAUT}finally rise up against the machines...!
Yeah, right! There's no way!
Perhaps what's left of humanity is being{SAUT}kept in a cryogenic sleep somewhere?
Ah, I was thinking the same thing.{PAGE}Perhaps what's left of humanity is being{SAUT}kept in a cryogenic sleep somewhere?
I see. There's a possibility they're being{SAUT}stored in large numbers and turned into{SAUT}living batteries...
In a way, using humans as a natural{SAUT}resource would be the ultimate form of{SAUT}eco-friendliness. I'm rather intrigued.
Nope! No way! You guys are scaring me,{SAUT}talkin' like that!
Okay, everyone, enough daydreaming{SAUT}for now. We should get going.
